T: Sam cooks rabbit. We do potatoes.
D: The fellowship is broken and the war for Middle-earth begins in earnest.
P: Serve the stew when Sam cooks the rabbits in Ithilien.
S: Baby potatoes boiled, smashed flat and roasted until crisp

Baby potatoes boiled, smashed flat and roasted until shatteringly crisp, tossed in garlic and herb butter, with a sour cream and chive dip. Boil 1kg baby potatoes for 15 minutes until tender, drain and steam dry. Put on an oiled tray and press each flat with a mug. Drizzle with olive oil and salt and roast at 230C for 30 to 35 minutes until deep golden. Melt 40g butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves, thyme and rosemary and pour over. Mix 200ml sour cream with snipped chives and salt for the dip.
Merry and Pippin find the stores at Isengard

Pork belly cured overnight in salt and sugar, roasted then crisped into cubes and glazed with apple cider vinegar and honey, on toothpicks with pickles. Rub 1kg skin-off pork belly with 2 tbsp salt and 1 tbsp brown sugar and cure in the fridge overnight. Rinse, pat dry and roast at 160C for 2 hours. Cool, then cut into 3cm cubes. Fry in a hot pan until crisp on all sides, then add 2 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp cider vinegar and toss until sticky. Serve on toothpicks with cornichons and wholegrain mustard.
Honey oat bars baked crisp, served with sharp cheddar
Oatcakes of oats, butter, honey and salt baked at 180C for 20 minutes, with sharp cheese and apples.
M: Rabbit or chicken stewed with ale, carrots and potatoes
Rabbit or chicken thighs browned, onion, carrot and thyme, stock and a splash of ale, potatoes added, simmered 90 minutes until tender.
Edoras garlic and rosemary roast lamb
the golden mead hall at Edoras

Lamb leg studded with garlic and rosemary, roasted pink and carved at the table, with crisp potatoes, honey-roast root veg and a rich red wine gravy. Heat the oven to 220C. Make 12 small cuts in a 2kg lamb leg and push in slivers from 4 garlic cloves and rosemary sprigs. Rub with oil and salt. Roast on a bed of 1kg potatoes, 3 carrots and 2 parsnips in chunks for 20 minutes, then at 180C for 60 minutes to about 58C inside. Rest 20 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp flour into the tray juices, add 150ml red wine and 300ml beef stock and simmer to a gravy.
W: Buttery honey shortbread cut into squares

Rich shortbread squares wrapped in a leaf, the closest thing to Elvish waybread. Beat 250g butter with 100g sugar and 2 tbsp honey, then mix in 350g plain flour and a pinch of salt. Press 1cm thick into a tray, score into squares and bake at 160C for 30 minutes. Cut while warm and wrap each in a clean leaf or baking paper.
K: Mead and apple juice warmed with orange, cinnamon, cloves and honey

Mead warmed with apple juice, honey, cinnamon, clove and orange, served steaming in horn cups or mugs, with a booze-free pot alongside. Pour a 750ml bottle of mead and 500ml cloudy apple juice into a pot with 1 sliced orange, 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves and 2 tbsp honey. Warm gently for 15 minutes without boiling. Ladle into mugs with an orange slice. For a booze-free pot, use 1.2 litres apple juice with the same spices.
